sessionsBySequence.sessiontitle: Building the AI-Powered Agentic Enterprise with Google Cloud
sessionsBySequence.description:
The paradigm of enterprise automation is undergoing a seismic shift. Modern organizations are moving rapidly beyond passive generative models and static chatbots toward goal-driven, autonomous **agentic systems**. Welcome to the era of the **AI-Powered Agentic Enterprise**—where intelligent Google AI agents don't merely generate responses; they reason, orchestrate complex multi-step workflows, analyze real-time enterprise data, and execute critical business operations with precision and speed. 

In this flagship session, discover how Google Cloud’s state-of-the-art AI infrastructure, Vertex AI platform, and Gemini models empower enterprises to transform core business processes from end to end. Learn how world-class organizations are moving from isolated AI pilots to fully integrated, agentic architectures that drive unprecedented productivity, resilience, and operational agility.

sessionsBySequence.sessiontitle: Built for This Moment and Beyond: The Autonomous Enterprise​
sessionsBySequence.description: From bold strategic pivots, technology bets to deep cultural shifts, enterprise agendas are evolving rapidly. Join this strategy session grounded in enterprise reality, exploring the underlying opportunities and challenges, and go beyond the hype and decipher your AI-driven digital transformation at scale. The Autonomous Enterprise is no longer a distant vision—it is the mindset and the way of work that is already reshaping how business gets done. Join us to jointly decipher your path from pilot to production-aligning strategy, processes and culture and realizing value for your business.

sessionsBySequence.sessiontitle: Your Corporate Card Is Now a Conversation
sessionsBySequence.description:
# Talk to Pay: Reimagining Corporate Cards Through Conversational AI

  

**What if your employees could request a corporate virtual card just by sending a message?**

  

No portals. No forms. No waiting on IT. Just a conversation.

  

At SAP Concur, we turned that vision into production reality. We have built a conversational AI experience embedded into the channels employees already use — SMS — that lets them request and recharge virtual corporate cards through natural language, with enterprise-grade security baked in from day one.

  

## The Experience

  

An employee types *"I need a card for my Singapore trip, $2,000 budget."* The AI understands, asks only what's missing, confirms the details, sends a one-time passcode to verify identity, and submits the card application — all inside a single conversation.

  

## What You'll See

  

- A live walkthrough of the card request and recharge experience

- How AI handles ambiguity, incomplete requests, and corrections gracefully

- The security model that makes financial transactions safe in a chat interface

- What it took to bring this from idea to production at enterprise scale

  

## Why It Matters

  

Corporate card management is broken — slow, frustrating, and designed for finance teams, not employees. This session shows how conversational AI makes financial workflows feel effortless, while keeping compliance and security intact.

  

**For:** Product managers, designers, business leaders, and anyone shaping enterprise employee experience.

sessionsBySequence.sessiontitle: Observability First: Tracing, Explainability, and OpenTelemetry for Production AI Agents
sessionsBySequence.description: **You cannot improve what you cannot observe — and for AI agents, explainability is also a regulatory requirement under frameworks like GDPR. This session builds from first principles: why observability enables explainability (you need the raw telemetry before you can explain decisions), and how SAP is adopting OpenTelemetry as the standard for agent telemetry — traces, metrics, and logs across distributed multi-cloud environments. We'll walk through practical integration for code-based agents on AppFND (App Foundation SDK telemetry, semantic conventions for GenAI, Python SDK tracing), MLflow for agent trace observability on AI Core, and how to structure spans and attributes so your observability data is useful across any vendor toolchain. Real examples from production SAP agent deployments showing how tracing reveals root causes that testing alone never surfaces.**

sessionsBySequence.sessiontitle: SAP Business Data Cloud: The Data Foundation for Autonomous Enterprises
sessionsBySequence.description:
As enterprises move toward an agentic future, trusted, contextualized, and semantically rich data becomes the foundation for intelligent decision-making and autonomous business processes. 

SAP Business Data Cloud brings together SAP and third-party data with governance, business context, and semantics—creating a unified data foundation for enterprise AI. 

This session explores how BDC enables AI agents to access the right data, understand business context, and turn insights into action, accelerating the journey toward autonomous enterprises.

sessionsBySequence.sessiontitle: SAP RPT in Action: Predicting Customer Payment Delays with Enterprise Intelligence
sessionsBySequence.description:

Through a live demonstration, we will connect and analyse customer, invoice, sales, and financial transaction data to uncover hidden relationships and risk indicators. Using these business signals, SAP RPT identifies patterns associated with late payments and generates predictive insights that help organizations take preventive action.

sessionsBySequence.sessiontitle: From Manual to Autonomous: AI and Agents Transforming Invoice Processing
sessionsBySequence.description:
This session offers an early preview of the AI and agentic capabilities being built into **SAP Concur Invoice**, covering:

-   **Unified Invoice Management** – A reimagined Invoice Manager that reduces noise, surfaces exceptions, and keeps AP processing moving efficiently.
-   **AI-assisted Invoice Intake** – Intelligent capture that automates document separation, data extraction, and verification in a single streamlined flow.
-   **AI-assisted Expense Type Classification** – Automatic, context-aware mapping of invoice line items to the right expense categories.
-   **Intelligent Duplicate Detection** – AI that identifies duplicate invoices early in the process, reducing financial risk and rework.
-   **Japan Withholding Tax Support** – Purpose-built compliance coverage for Japan WHT requirements.
-   **Agentic Capabilities on the Roadmap** – A forward look at autonomous agents covering classification, PO matching, custom field coding, and approvals — moving AP toward true autonomy.

sessionsBySequence.sessiontitle: Beyond Copilots: How Autonomous AI Agents Are Redefining Customer Experience
sessionsBySequence.description:
What happens when AI moves beyond recommending the next action and starts taking action itself?

SAP is fundamentally reimagining Customer Experience through **Autonomous CX** — where AI agents understand business context, reason across processes, collaborate with other agents, and execute business actions, with humans involved when decisions require oversight.

In this lecture, we will use a real-world customer scenario to demonstrate an end-to-end autonomous CX journey — from **customer engagement and lead qualification through opportunity management, quote creation, and service resolution**.

The **real-time demo** will show how multiple AI agents can:

-   Understand customer and business context
-   Analyze opportunities and identify risks
-   Recommend and execute next-best actions
-   Create and update business transactions
-   Collaborate across Sales, Commerce, and Service processes
-   Escalate decisions to humans when approval or judgment is required

We will then go behind the scenes to explain how SAP's architecture enables this experience — with **Joule as the conversational front door, the SAP Autonomous Suite powering business processes, Industry AI providing domain intelligence, and the SAP Business AI Platform providing context, data, governance, and auditability**.

The session will conclude with practical guidance on identifying **high-value processes for autonomy**, designing agent-driven workflows, establishing human-in-the-loop guardrails, and measuring business impact.

**Attendees will leave with a practical understanding of how to move from AI-assisted tasks to autonomous, outcome-driven customer experiences.**

sessionsBySequence.sessiontitle: AI Adapter in Action: Connecting SAP Cloud Integration with LLMs and AI Agents
sessionsBySequence.description: What happens when an integration flow can go beyond moving data and start interacting with AI? In this session, we’ll explore how the AI Adapter in SAP Cloud Integration can connect integration flows with LLMs and AI Agents to bring intelligence into real-world integration scenarios. Through practical use cases, we’ll see how an integration flow can interact with AI agents, retrieve context-aware information, and use AI-generated insights as part of the integration process. The session will highlight the possibilities of combining SAP Cloud Integration, AI Adapter, LLMs, and AI Agents to build the next generation of intelligent integrations.

sessionsBySequence.sessiontitle: MCP, A2A, and Knowledge Graph API Discovery: The New Tool Layer for SAP AI Agents
sessionsBySequence.description: The tool philosophy for SAP AI agents is shifting: foundation models can now follow complex instructions reliably enough that teams should consolidate workflow steps into AI reasoning rather than building deterministic tools for every operation. But when explicit tool creation IS needed, MCP (Model Context Protocol) is now the standard and Knowledge Graph-based API discovery is the emerging direction, letting agents dynamically find and invoke SAP LOB APIs (S/4HANA, SuccessFactors, Ariba) without per-endpoint MCP wrappers. This session covers the full tool landscape: when to use KG-based dynamic discovery vs. explicit MCP servers, the four ways to build MCP Servers at SAP (MCP Builder, CAP MCP Adapter, ABAP Cloud, Integration Suite), and how A2A (Agent-to-Agent) protocol connects SAP agents to external ecosystems via the Agent Gateway. Includes live architecture decisions from the MCP Tools Target Architecture ADR.

sessionsBySequence.sessiontitle: From Policy to Payment in Minutes: How AI is Reinventing Corporate Virtual Card Management
sessionsBySequence.description:
This session showcases how **SAP Concur** is leveraging AI to transform corporate virtual card management, eliminating manual configuration, slow approvals, and friction-heavy issuance flows. Key highlights include:

-   **AI-powered Card Program Creation** – Admins upload policy documents and AI automatically extracts spending limits and configures MCC allow/block rules, generating a ready-to-submit card program template.

_Ideal for Product Managers, Engineers, UX Practitioners, and customers evaluating SAP Concur's virtual card program._

sessionsBySequence.sessiontitle: Beyond Standard AI: Extending SAP Agents for Your Business
sessionsBySequence.description:
**Unlocking AI Innovation with SAP Agent Extensibility**

How SAP’s Extensibility Service enables customers and partners to safely extend enterprise AI with custom skills, tools, and business logic—while preserving the clean core.

AI is transforming how users interact with enterprise applications, but every business has unique processes, rules, and competitive differentiators. **Agent Extensibility** enables organizations to bring these unique requirements into SAP’s agentic world without compromising standardization, governance, or upgradeability.

In this session, discover how **Agent Extension**, as a core capability of SAP’s Extensibility Service and Suite Foundation Services, enables developers and partners to extend SAP AI agents with **custom Skills, Tools, and Pre/Post Hooks**. See how the **Extension Registry** provides centralized discovery and governance, while SAP’s publishing and deployment services enable extensions to move from development to productive landscapes in a structured and scalable way.

We will also explore how Agent Extensibility fits into the broader SAP extensibility architecture, alongside **Domain Model and UI Extensions**, and how it integrates with SAP applications and the **SAP BTP** technology foundation.

Finally, experience how **SAP Build** brings an agentic engagement layer to extensibility—using natural language and AI-assisted development to make extension capabilities accessible to professional developers, partners, and business technologists.

**Key takeaways:**

-   Extend SAP agents with **custom Skills and Tools** for differentiated business scenarios
    
-   Use **Pre/Post Hooks** to inject custom business logic into agent-driven processes
    
-   Discover, govern, and manage extensions through the **Extension Registry**
    
-   Understand how Agent Extensibility supports the **clean-core** strategy
    
-   See how extensions are published and deployed through governed lifecycle services
    
-   Explore how **SAP Build** enables intent-based and agent-assisted extensibility

sessionsBySequence.sessiontitle: Architecting AI-Native Solutions for the Autonomous Enterprise
sessionsBySequence.description: Get an architect’s view of how SAP’s AI guidance shapes AI-native solutions. See how the AI-Native North Star, AI Golden Path, and reference architectures connect, from UX and business processes to data, AI, and platform services. Learn where to start, how to choose the right building blocks for AI agents, and how to turn ideas into secure, governed architecture.

sessionsBySequence.sessiontitle: From Intent to Action: Transforming work with Joule Work, Assistants & Agents
sessionsBySequence.description:
What if getting work done across SAP didn't require switching between applications, searching for information, or manually coordinating tasks and handoffs?

Joule Work brings data, applications, Joule Assistants, and agent workflows together in a dynamic workspace, enabling people to express what they want to accomplish and let AI help move the work forward.

In this session, we will explore how Joule Assistants orchestrate specialised Joule Agents to turn business intent into action. Agents can work sequentially or in parallel, connecting the right data, tools, and applications to analyse information, trigger actions, interact with systems, and execute workflow steps across the enterprise.

Through practical business scenarios, we'll look at how Joule Work can automate routine cross-functional work, coordinate activities across systems, and help teams move faster from insight to outcome. We will also discuss how this AI-driven experience fits with the SAP Business AI Platform, including governance, role-based access, data permissions, monitoring, auditability, and human oversight.

The session will provide a practical view of how AI agents can move beyond answering questions to actually orchestrating work—and what this means for the future of enterprise productivity.


What Will the Audience Gain?
Attendees will leave with:
-   Understand Joule Work — how it brings data, applications, assistants, and agent workflows together in one workspace.
-   See how Assistants and Agents work together — understand the roles of Joule Assistants, Joule Agents, and agent orchestration.
-   Learn how intent becomes action— see how AI can move from understanding a request to executing tasks across systems.
-   Explore real business scenarios — understand how multi-agent orchestration can automate cross-functional workflows and reduce manual handoffs.
-   Understand sequential vs. parallel agent execution — and how specialised agents can collaborate to complete an end-to-end workflow.
-   Learn about enterprise AI governance — understand how Joule Work interacts with the SAP Business AI Platform's controls for access, permissions, monitoring, auditability, and human oversight.
-   Identify opportunities in your own organisation — take away ideas for where AI-powered orchestration can improve productivity and accelerate business outcomes.

sessionsBySequence.sessiontitle: From AI Features to Autonomous Processes: Decoding SAP’s AI Strategy
sessionsBySequence.description:
What changes when AI moves from assisting users to acting across business processes?

AI is rapidly moving beyond individual features and assistants toward systems that can understand business context, reason across processes, and take action. But with new models, agents, platforms, and capabilities emerging so quickly, how do the pieces of SAP’s AI strategy fit together—and what does this evolution really mean for SAP technology teams?

This session takes a practical look at the journey from **embedded AI and AI assistants to AI agents and increasingly autonomous business processes**. Rather than presenting SAP’s AI portfolio as a list of capabilities, we will connect the dots between **SAP Business AI, Joule, AI Foundation, business data and context, Generative AI Hub, AI agents, and the Autonomous Enterprise**.

Through selected real-world examples, we will explore how AI is evolving from helping users perform individual tasks to supporting and orchestrating end-to-end business processes. We will also examine why **business context, data, process integration, governance, security, and human oversight** become increasingly important as AI moves from generating answers to taking actions.

The session will highlight what this shift means for **developers, architects, consultants, quality engineers, product teams, and other technology practitioners** building and delivering SAP solutions.

The goal is not simply to understand where SAP is today, but to develop a practical perspective on **where enterprise AI is heading, how the different pieces fit together, and what technology teams should start thinking about now**.

**From AI that assists with a task, to AI that participates in a process—and ultimately helps orchestrate the outcome.**

sessionsBySequence.sessiontitle: Trusted AI Agents: Quality, Human-in-the-Loop & Governance at SAP
sessionsBySequence.description: You can't ship what you can't measure — yet for AI agents, clean baselines and ground truth datasets are scarce. This session covers SAP's end-to-end evaluation strategy for AI agents as codified in the AI Golden Path: human-in-the-loop verification as the primary validation method, LLM-as-a-judge as a complement (not a replacement), and how Agent Hub serves as the central governance layer where agents are activated, monitored, and controlled. We'll cover the full lifecycle — Discover, Activate, Run, Extend, Build, Evaluate, Monitor & Govern — with practical examples of how SAP application teams instrument observability, metering, and auditability into their agents from day one, not as an afterthought.

sessionsBySequence.sessiontitle: Build Secure, Enterprise-Ready Custom AI-Powered Capabilities in SAP S/4HANA
sessionsBySequence.description: Discover how Intelligent Scenario Lifecycle Management (ISLM) enables organizations to build, integrate, manage both Generative AI and Tabular AI in SAP S/4HANA. In this session, you'll learn how to develop secure, enterprise-ready AI solutions using SAP AI Core Orchestration with built-in safeguards such as grounding, masking, and filtering, while also leveraging SAP RPT to build, and deploy models that deliver business-specific predictions. Gain practical experience in accelerating AI innovation with end-to-end lifecycle management, governance, and seamless integration into business applications.

sessionsBySequence.sessiontitle: The New Architecture of Hiring: AI, Agents and SmartRecruiters
sessionsBySequence.description:
**What happens when we stop using AI simply to make existing recruiting workflows faster — and instead rethink the architecture underneath hiring?**

For years, recruiters have acted as the coordination layer between candidates, hiring managers, interviewers, calendars, messaging tools, recruiting systems and business processes. Adding another AI tool can improve individual steps, but it does not necessarily remove that architectural complexity.

In this session, we will explore how an AI-first hiring architecture can move coordination from people into the platform while keeping humans in control of the decisions that matter.

Using SmartRecruiters, Winston AI and SAP SuccessFactors as the example architecture, we will look at:

- how a talent operating system and AI layer work together;
- how enterprise hiring connects with candidates, recruiters, calendars, interviewers and workforce systems; and
a practical interview scheduling example showing what changes when the architecture itself performs the coordination.

The session will include a product walkthrough/demo and practical architecture principles that SAP architects, consultants, product professionals and HR technology practitioners can apply when evaluating AI-first business processes.

**Key takeaway:** AI transformation is not only about adding intelligence to individual tasks. The bigger opportunity is redesigning where coordination, context and decisions live in the enterprise architecture.

sessionsBySequence.sessiontitle: From Weeks to Mins: Reimagining SAP’s Suite-First & AI-First Experience with Agentic Deployment Hub
sessionsBySequence.description:
**From Weeks to Mins: Reimagining SAP’s Suite-First & AI-First Experience with Agentic Deployment Hub**

Customers expect rapid value from SAP cloud applications, yet moving from subscription to adoption can take weeks or months due to setup, personalization, configuration, integrations, and baseline activities. Deployment Hub closes this Time-to-Value gap.

Deployment Hub is a SAP BTP application providing a guided experience for accelerating initial setup. It does not deploy the application; it makes it ready for customers to use sooner.

The platform brings setup activities together and uses personalization and integration accelerators, allowing users to focus on business outcomes. Automation can compress weeks or months of effort into minutes or hours.

**AI-First Evolution**

The Deployment Hub Baselining Agent introduces AI-assisted setup. AI can understand intent, guide users, accelerate baselining, and reduce the expertise required for repetitive activities. Deterministic automation handles known configuration reliably. Together, they deliver an intelligent yet controlled enterprise experience.

**One Experience, Multiple Personas**

Deployment Hub supports customers, consultants, partners, and administrators through a common platform—accelerating repetitive setup and providing operational visibility.

**Built for the SAP Ecosystem**

The Deployment Hub Framework provides a consistent experience while accommodating application-specific setup requirements. Its BTP foundation supports multi-tenancy, security, extensibility, integrations, monitoring, automation, and AI-assisted baselining.

**The Bigger Idea**

Deployment Hub turns the journey from subscription to adoption into a product-innovation opportunity. Every manual step removed brings customers closer to solving business problems with SAP.

**The vision: customers should spend their time using SAP applications—not setting them up.**

sessionsBySequence.sessiontitle: From SAP Managed Data Products to Insights: The end to end BDC journey for S4 PCE
sessionsBySequence.description:

Most S/4HANA Private Cloud Edition customers still treat analytics as a data acquisition problem — extracting, replicating, and remodeling ERP data before anyone sees a dashboard. SAP Business Data Cloud changes the economics of this journey: SAP-managed data products ship curated, semantically rich, continuously maintained datasets directly from S/4HANA PCE, ready for zero-copy consumption.

This session walks developers, engineers, and partners through the complete journey — from understanding what an SAP-managed data product actually is to activating it in SAP Analytics Cloud for planning and analytics. A live demo traces a single business scenario end to end: discovering a SAP Managed data product in the BDC catalog, installing and activating it, and building an SAC story and insight app on top

Attendees leave with a working mental model of the "activation, not acquisition" paradigm, a decision framework for when to use managed data products versus custom modeling, and practical guidance on prerequisites, licensing touchpoints, and common pitfalls in PCE landscapes.

**What Attendees Will Learn**
1. The anatomy of an SAP-managed data product
2. The BDC architecture underneath
3. The activation journey step by step
4. Generating Insights
5. Design decisions and trade-offs
6. Best Practices

**Key Takeaways**
A reference architecture and decision framework for the PCE → BDC → SAC journey

**Target Audience:** 
Developers, data engineers, architects, and SAP partners/consultants working on S/4HANA PCE analytics or advising customers on BDC adoption. Beginner/Intermediate level.

**Prerequisites:** 
Working knowledge of S/4HANA and basic familiarity with SAP Analytics Cloud; exposure to CDS views. No hands-on setup needed.

sessionsBySequence.sessiontitle: CAP Guardian - AI Powered Self-Healing Applications on CAP
sessionsBySequence.description:
This session demonstrates **“Doctor for Your Apps”**, an AI-powered approach to automatically detecting, analyzing, and fixing issues in SAP cloud applications.

The session will show how an application running on **SAP BTP** can be monitored by a Watcher component that detects application errors, crashes, and runtime issues. The Watcher collects the relevant logs and technical information and triggers a Healer service. The Healer uses AI to analyze the failure, identify the possible root cause, and generate a minimal code fix, while keeping a **human-in-the-loop** for approval before the change is applied and redeployed.

The solution also demonstrates how different SAP technologies can work together in this workflow, including **SAP BTP, CAP, Github, SAP HANA Cloud Vector Engine, Document AI, and Generative AI**.

HANA Vector Engine can be used to provide semantic retrieval of relevant application knowledge and previous incidents, while Document AI can help extract structured information from supporting documents when required. These capabilities provide additional context to the AI before it proposes a fix.

## Key Takeaways

- Understand how to build an AI-assisted self-healing architecture for applications running on **SAP BTP**.
- See how **CAP, SAP HANA Cloud/HANA Vector Engine, Document AI, and Generative AI** can be combined in a practical solution.
- Learn how application logs and runtime failures can trigger an automated diagnostic and remediation workflow.
- Understand how vector search can provide relevant application and incident context to an AI model.
- Explore how **human-in-the-loop approval** can make AI-driven code remediation safer and more controlled.
- See how the complete flow can go from **application failure → diagnosis → AI-generated fix → approval → code change → redeployment**.

## Target Audience

This session is aimed at **SAP developers, CAP developers, BTP developers, solution architects, technical leads, DevOps/application support teams, and SAP professionals interested in Generative AI and intelligent automation**.

It will be particularly useful for attendees exploring **SAP BTP, SAP HANA Cloud, CAP, AI services, application monitoring, and autonomous application operations**.

## Prerequisites

Attendees should have a basic understanding of **SAP BTP and cloud application development**. Familiarity with CAP, SAP HANA Cloud, application logs, APIs, and basic Generative AI concepts will help, but deep knowledge of AI or machine learning is not required.

sessionsBySequence.sessiontitle: Understanding Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and implementing it through Joule Desktop
sessionsBySequence.description:
From LLMs to RAG Agents: Building AI That Knows Your Data

Generative AI has transformed how we build intelligent applications, but LLMs can still struggle when they need to answer questions using private, domain-specific, or frequently changing information. This is where Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) becomes a powerful approach.

In this session, we will take a practical journey through the architecture of a RAG-based AI agent, exploring how information moves from documents and knowledge sources to embeddings, vector search, retrieval, and finally to an LLM-generated response.

We will go beyond the basic RAG pipeline and explore how retrieval quality can be improved using techniques such as effective document chunking, semantic retrieval, multi-query retrieval, hybrid search, result fusion, and reranking. We will also look at how these concepts can be applied when building enterprise-grade AI applications.

The session will include a practical walkthrough of a RAG agent, demonstrating how retrieved c

In this session, we will explore the complete spectrum of extensibility in SAP S/4HANA Fiori apps. From the key-user perspective, we will demonstrate low-code/no-code in-app extensibility capabilities that enable rapid business adaptations. We will also dive into developer extensibility techniques using SAP Business Application Studio, focusing on app variants and advanced customization approaches to address complex business requirements.

A common challenge in enterprise projects is the seamless collaboration between key users and developers. sessionsBySequence.sessiontitle: Building Clean-Core On-Stack Extensions in SAP S/4HANA Cloud with RAP and Reusable Services
sessionsBySequence.description:
Keeping the core clean is foundational to SAP Cloud ERP, yet business scenarios with high data proximity and transactional dependency demand more than side-by-side extensibility on SAP BTP. For tightly coupled processes, on-stack developer extensibility within SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition provides the path forward, enabling standard enhancements without modifying standard code.

The On-Stack Partner Reference Application (PRA) serves as an end-to-end blueprint for implementing these clean-core patterns. Built on the ABAP RESTful Application Programming Model (RAP) and modern ABAP Cloud principles, this reference architecture demonstrates how to deliver upgrade-stable, scalable extensions. Key focus areas include:

-   **RAP Architecture & Modeling:** Designing clean data models and business logic layers that seamlessly integrate with standard SAP business objects.
    
-   **Platform Reuse Services:** Implementing native technical services, including Number Ranges, Application Logs, Background Processing (Application Jobs), and Email Notifications.
    
-   **Upgrade-Safe Extensibility:** Applying released standard APIs and extension points to future-proof custom logic against continuous cloud release cycles.

sessionsBySequence.sessiontitle: Five Ways Claude Goes Wrong Without a Spec — and How to Stop Each One
sessionsBySequence.description:
Agentic AI is fast. That is precisely what makes it dangerous without guardrails. This session opens with five failure modes observed in real SAP BTP codebases when Claude Code operates without a spec: scope creep, wrong abstraction, context loss, constraint blindness, unverifiable output.

For each failure mode, we demonstrate the problem live on a Deployment Hub feature, then show exactly how the SDD artifact chain prevents it: `proposal.md` locks scope, `design.md` mandates the approach, bounded tasks prevent context loss, the constitution enforces constraints, and the converge loop verifies output against written acceptance criteria before the PR is raised.

A practical session for teams that have already tried AI coding and hit the wall.

**Key takeaways:** Live demonstration of each failure mode on a real SAP Java + HANA codebase · The structural fix for each failure — not workarounds, but methodology · How `/speckit.converge` catches what you missed before code review does

sessionsBySequence.sessiontitle: The AI Ecosystem in SAP - Simplified for Beginners
sessionsBySequence.description:

Attendees will discover:

sessionsBySequence.sessiontitle: The Doc You Needed: Building an AI-Powered Technical Enablement Assistant with MCP
sessionsBySequence.description:
**SAP already has thousands of tutorials, reference architectures, sample repositories, and technical resources—but finding the right information at the right moment remains a challenge.**

In this session, we’ll explore how an **AI-powered Technical Enablement Assistant** can turn SAP’s existing knowledge into a personalized, grounded experience directly within the tools developers already use.

Through a **live technical demo and walkthrough**, you’ll see how **Model Context Protocol (MCP), SAP AI Core / Generative AI Hub, and SAP HANA Cloud Vector Engine** come together to enable:

-   **Grounded RAG** that retrieves relevant SAP knowledge and provides source-backed answers.
-   **Personalized learning paths** based on a developer’s existing knowledge and familiarity with AI concepts.
-   **AI architecture guidance** grounded in SAP’s technical content rather than generic LLM knowledge.
-   **Golden Path validation** to assess repositories against SAP AI development best practices.
-   **Multi-client access** through a single MCP server across MCP-capable tools such as Claude Desktop, VS Code, and BAS Joule.

The session will focus on a **reuse-first approach**: rather than rebuilding knowledge that SAP already has, learn how to **surface, personalize, and operationalize existing content through AI**.

You’ll leave with a practical understanding of how to build a similar **AI-first technical enablement pattern on SAP BTP**, including MCP-based integration, vector-based retrieval, grounded AI responses, personalization, and developer guidance—with working code and architecture you can apply to your own scenarios.

sessionsBySequence.sessiontitle: Agentic AI for Tax Compliance Automation
sessionsBySequence.description:
### Problem Identified

The tax compliance process relied on manual interpretation of SOPs to extract tax rules and create prompts, making it time-intensive, difficult to scale, and dependent on individual expertise.

### Insight and Opportunity

While exploring Agentic AI capabilities,identified an opportunity to challenge this process. Inspired by how AI agents such as Cline/Claude Code can understand complex documentation and generate structured outputs, hypothesized that AI could directly interpret tax SOPs and derive the required rules and prompts without extensive manual intervention.

### Experimentation and Validation

To validate this idea, conducted experiments using SOP documents as input and assessed the AI's ability to extract business rules and generate tax-check prompts. The results demonstrated the feasibility of AI-assisted rule discovery and prompt generation.

### Outcome and Impact

The findings established a new direction for automating knowledge-intensive tax compliance activities. This work influenced the adoption of Agentic AI concepts for compliance automation and highlighted a scalable approach to reducing manual effort, improving consistency, and accelerating future automation initiatives.

**Key Takeaways:**

-   **Unified Platform:** See how BAIP connects conversational AI, process intelligence, and IT governance.
-   **Intent-Based Build:** Learn how to generate custom agents in Joule Studio using plain-language business intents.
-   **Enterprise Governance:** Discover how to inventory agents in LeanIX and manage operations via Cloud ALM.

**Target Audience:**

-   Enterprise & Solution Architects designing secure AI landscapes.
-   BTP Developers & Business Technologists building custom agents.
-   Process Transformation Leads bridging process gaps with AI.

**Prerequisites:**

-   **Level:** Intermediate.
-   **Prerequisites:** Foundational understanding of SAP BTP and cloud architecture. Prior familiarity with Joule, Signavio, or Cloud ALM is helpful but not required.

sessionsBySequence.sessiontitle: Reimagining Enterprise Mobile Solutions with AI in Joule Work
sessionsBySequence.description:
This proposal introduces a platform-first mobile architecture built natively on SAP BTP, using SAP Fiori Elements as the core UI paradigm. Rather than hand-coding mobile screens, the platform generates them from metadata OData/CDS annotations drive standard floorplans (List Report, Object Page, Worklist) that render consistently across devices. This gives application teams a stable, versioned foundation that abstracts mobile-specific technical complexity, so they can focus on business logic and data modeling rather than UI plumbing. The platform's content is generated dynamically through BTP's application foundation and reusable services, integrating seamlessly with ABAP Cloud and CAP programming models. Layered on top, generative AI capabilities enable prompt-based filtering and agentic content discovery, giving end users a faster, more personalised way to interact with enterprise data on mobile devices.

**1\. Platform-First Architecture for Mobile Excellence**  
The platform establishes a robust foundation built on stable contracts, comprehensive versioning, and backward compatibility, enabling enterprise-grade mobile experiences that scale. Because Fiori Elements screens are metadata-driven, UI consistency is enforced by design rather than by convention annotation changes propagate automatically across List Report, Object Page, and Worklist floorplans without app-level rework. This abstracts infrastructure complexity while ensuring consistent UI components, lightweight architecture, and superior performance out of the box.

**2\. Developer Productivity Through Separation of Concerns**  
Application teams can focus exclusively on business workflows, data models, and CDS/OData annotations, while the Fiori Elements framework and platform handle mobile-specific rendering, navigation, and technical complexity. This separation accelerates development cycles, reduces technical debt, and enables rapid iteration on business-critical features a new field or action typically means an annotation change, not a new screen to build and maintain.

**3\. BTP-Native Content Generation**  
Leveraging SAP BTP's application foundation and reusable services, the platform dynamically generates mobile-optimised Fiori Elements content directly from CDS view and OData service annotations. This BTP-native approach ensures seamless integration with ABAP Cloud and CAP programming models, delivering consistent, floorplan-based mobile experiences across diverse enterprise landscapes without divergent custom UIs.

**4\. AI-Powered Intelligent Filtering**  
Integrated generative AI capabilities enable prompt-based filtering and content discovery layered on top of the standard Fiori Elements floorplans, transforming how users interact with enterprise data on mobile devices. This agentic workflow approach reduces friction, enhances productivity, and personalizes the mobile experience based on natural language inputs surfacing the right List Report filters or Object Page sections without manual navigation.

**Strategic Alignment**  
Application Foundation: demonstrates reusable services, SDK patterns, and modern programming models. Platform Capabilities: exemplifies unified services delivering consistency, reliability, and scalability through the Fiori Elements framework. AI Innovation: implements business AI for enhanced user experience and intelligent automation.

**Why This Matters**  
Together, these pillars position the platform as a reusable, enterprise-grade Fiori Elements foundation for mobile development on SAP BTP reducing time-to-market for application teams, ensuring long-term architectural and UI consistency, and bringing business AI directly into the hands of mobile users.

sessionsBySequence.sessiontitle: When Everything Is Green, But the Business Still Breaks |
sessionsBySequence.description:
When Everything Is Green, But the Business Still Breaks | 
From Scope Items to Business Outcomes: Rethinking End-to-End Quality in SAP

A technical, experience-driven session on designing meaningful end-to-end quality across interconnected SAP business processes.

**When Everything Passes, But the Business Process Fails: Rethinking End-to-End Quality in SAP**

What does it really mean when every test is green?

In complex SAP landscapes, individual test cases, applications, integrations, and scope items can all pass validation, while the end-to-end business process still fails to deliver the expected business outcome.

This session explores the gap between **test success and business success**, and why quality needs to be designed around the business process rather than individual test boundaries.

Drawing on practical experience with **SAP Best Practice content, scope items, test automation, and end-to-end customer scenarios**, we will look at how multiple scope items, applications, integrations, data, and process steps come together to form a meaningful business journey.

The session will cover how to identify critical **process, data, and integration dependencies**, design meaningful E2E scenarios, determine the right level of test coverage, and make informed decisions about what should—and should not—be automated.

We will also look at the difference between **automation coverage, test coverage, E2E process coverage, and business-risk coverage**, and how these perspectives can help teams build confidence in outcomes that matter to customers.

The goal is to move beyond asking **“Did our tests pass?”** to asking **“Can the business successfully complete the journey?”**

sessionsBySequence.sessiontitle: From Embedded AI to Agents: Navigating the Autonomous Enterprise

sessionsBySequence.sessiontitle: Rethinking Public Sector Sourcing in SAP Fieldglass
sessionsBySequence.description:
Public sector organizations—especially across Europe—run sourcing through **competitive tenders and require strict control over candidate submissions**, all while handling large volumes of applicants efficiently. This session shares a real-world SAP Fieldglass solution, built for **a large European public sector organization**, that combines **compliance** with **intelligence**.

First, we enable sealed, controlled sourcing: Job Submissions are **locked at submission and hidden until the deadline passes**, then revealed only when authorized roles (**Coordinators and Distributors**) unlock them—enforcing fairness and regulatory compliance in competitive tenders.

Second, the moment submissions are revealed, they’re already **ranked using LLM-based AI resume assessment**, giving coordinators an instant, prioritized view instead of a manual review backlog. We’ll walk through the problem, the solution, and the real-world impact—closing with a look at how this ranking is **evolving into an AI agent in an upcoming release**.

## Key Points
-   **Solution Part A — Sealed submissions (shipped):** Job Submissions time-locked until deadline, role-based unlock.
-   **Solution Part B — LLM resume ranking (shipped):** Submissions arrive pre-ranked on reveal.
-   **Responsible AI:** Human-in-the-loop oversight; AI as decision support, not decision-maker.
-   **Impact:** Compliant, faster, and more consistent sourcing—reusable across public sector customers.
-   **What’s next (roadmap teaser):** The ranking capability evolving into an **AI agent** in a future release.

## Audience Takeaways
1.  How to adapt SAP Fieldglass job posting flows for **sealed, controlled sourcing in competitive tenders**.
2.  How **LLM-based resume ranking** streamlines evaluation while keeping humans in control.
3.  A **reusable pattern** for public sector organizations navigating EU regulatory requirements.

sessionsBySequence.sessiontitle: From Business Rules to Intelligent Decisions: BRF+ & AI in Action

You will learn:

-   **How is BRFplus structured?** Explore the key building blocks and how they work together to execute business rules.
-   **BRFplus in action:** See how business rules support real-world decision-making across different business scenarios.
-   **AI in BRFplus:** Discover how AI can help business process analysts understand complex rules, gain insights, identify configuration gaps and anomalies, and improve rule quality.
-   **From assistant to agents:** Explore how capabilities such as knowledge and advisory support can evolve toward **rule design and remediation**.

**Key takeaway:** BRFplus provides the foundation for managing business rules; AI can make those rules easier to understand, analyze, improve, and progressively automate.

**Target audience:** Business process analysts, product managers, solution architects, SAP consultants, and anyone interested in business rules, AI, and intelligent enterprise decision-making.

sessionsBySequence.sessiontitle: Connecting the Dots- An Ontology-First Autonomous Enterprise Application
sessionsBySequence.description:
**Project Narwhal turns raw enterprise data into a living knowledge layer that both people and AI agents can act on.**

The autonomous enterprise runs on systems that understand what data means — not just store it. That understanding lives in an "ontology" connecting a business's concepts and relationships, but it's usually hand-built by specialists and kept apart from the actual data, slowing everything down and holding AI agents back.

Narwhal, an AI-native tool on SAP BTP, closes that gap. Domain experts visually design, validate, and query knowledge graphs directly from live data in SAP HANA Cloud, Datasphere, and Dremio — with AI suggesting the model, plain-English querying, and one-click actions back into SAP systems like S/4HANA. The result: a semantic foundation that makes enterprise data trustworthy and machine-actionable — from data, to insight, to action.

PS : Disclaimer : We are not the original developers of Project Narwhal,but as part of Industry AI Team, we are one of the early adopters of this application and closely working with the Narwhal team to release enhanced versions. We are submitting this session for creating awareness about this project

sessionsBySequence.sessiontitle: I Haven't Written Code in 25 Years. Here's How I Built a Production SAP BTP App in 4 Months.

sessionsBySequence.sessiontitle: From Reactive Service to Preventive Maintenance: Building an AI assisted Voice Agent on SAP BTP

Most service organizations still rely on customers reporting issues before any action is taken. As a result, maintenance schedules are missed, warranty entitlements are underutilized, and customer satisfaction suffers.

This session demonstrates how to transform traditional service operations into an AI-driven preventive maintenance model using SAP Business Technology Platform (SAP BTP), SAP Service Cloud Version 2, SAP AI Core and Generative AI.

The solution leverages customer registered products, installation dates, warranty coverage, and service frequencies to automatically identify equipment that is approaching its next preventive maintenance milestone. An AI-powered voice agent proactively contacts customers, verifies availability through a natural language conversation, schedules maintenance appointments and creates service orders and service cases without requiring manual intervention from service teams.

Attendees will learn how SAP BTP can be used to:

-   Orchestrate AI agent workflows using SAP AI capabilities.
-   Enable voice-based customer engagement and appointment scheduling.

sessionsBySequence.sessiontitle: Nexus Incident Agent: AI-Driven Automated Ticket Resolution for Ariba Contracts
sessionsBySequence.description:
In modern enterprise landscape, incident resolution is often hindered by fragmented workflows, manual triaging, and loss of context across systems such as ServiceNow and JIRA. This session presents the **Nexus Incident Agent**, an AI-powered solution built to streamline and accelerate the entire incident management lifecycle—from ticket creation to resolution.

The Nexus Incident Agent integrates seamlessly with ServiceNow and JIRA, ingesting incident tickets along with their descriptions and attachments. Leveraging MCP servers, it continuously polls and consolidates data from these systems to create a unified and enriched context for every issue.

At its core, the system employs a multi-agent architecture powered by Claude Sonnet. Five specialized AI roles—**Architect, Developer, Reviewer, Tester, and Learner**—work collaboratively to analyze incidents, generate solutions, validate outputs, and continuously improve performance. This coordinated approach enables the agent to autonomously suggest fixes and even raise pull requests for human review.

To further enhance efficiency, a **contextual grounding layer** built using Claude Haiku organizes information into structured components such as Model, Dependencies, Overview, Authentication, Security, Service Handlers, and Tests. This reduces token usage, speeds up execution, and improves the accuracy of generated solutions.

As a result, the system significantly optimizes incident management, demonstrating the ability to **autonomously resolve up to 60% of monthly incidents**, while reducing manual effort and improving turnaround time.

**Key Takeaways:** 
- Multi-agent AI design
- ServiceNow/JIRA integration
- contextual grounding
- measurable efficiency gains.  

**Audience:** Engineers, architects, DevOps, AI practitioners.  
**Prerequisites:** Basics of microservices, APIs, and enterprise ticketing systems like ServiceNow and JIRA.

sessionsBySequence.sessiontitle: Less Tokens, More Value: How I Built a 30% Cost Optimization Layer for SAP Joule
sessionsBySequence.description:
Every time SAP Joule answers a question, it silently burns thousands of tokens of full conversation histories, entire HR policy document and system prompts all loaded into the context window on every single turn. At enterprise scale, this translates to €20M+ in annual LLM infrastructure costs, slower responses, and frustrated users hitting context overflow errors.

In this session, I will walk through how I identified this problem, built a business case worth €8M+ in annual savings, and proposed an intelligent token optimization layer for SAP Joule combining conversation summarization, prompt compression (LLMLingua-style), and context relevance pruning deployed transparently as a BTP middleware component with no UI changes required.

You will leave with a practical understanding of how LLM token consumption works in enterprise Joule deployments, techniques to reduce token usage by 25–35% without degrading response quality, a reusable business case methodology for AI cost optimization proposals, and the confidence to turn a real observation into an approved, funded AI use case at SAP.

sessionsBySequence.sessiontitle: From Inbox to Order: Automating Sales Order Creation with SAP Document AI
sessionsBySequence.description:
Many businesses still receive sales orders as PDF attachments over email — and behind the scenes, that often means a support team manually reading each PDF and keying data into SAP. It's slow, repetitive, and error-prone.

In this session, I'll walk through a real implementation where we automated this entire flow using SAP Document AI alongside Integration Suite and SAP Build. Emails land in a shared mailbox, an iFlow picks up the PDF and routes it to Document AI, which extracts key entities like customer and material information. That data is mapped and submitted via API to create the sales order in SAP — with a human-in-the-loop approval step surfaced right in the user's BTP inbox before the order is finalized.

I'll cover the end-to-end architecture, the extraction and mapping approach, how failures are monitored across Integration Suite and SAP Build, and the measurable impact: reduced manual effort, faster turnaround, and fewer errors. No confidential data or customer specifics will be shown — the focus is entirely on the architecture, design decisions, and lessons learned.

**Key Takeaways:**

-   How to architect a Document AI–driven extraction pipeline for unstructured email attachments
-   Practical approach to entity extraction (customer, material) and mapping into SAP APIs
-   Designing human-in-the-loop approval without slowing down automation
-   Monitoring and failure-handling strategy across Integration Suite and SAP Build
-   Real before/after impact metrics from a production use case

-   🤖 Automates endpoint, certificate, namespace, and infrastructure discovery
    
-   📊 Executes JMeter performance tests on EC2

The only prerequisite is to have the **service repository cloned locally**.

Simply tell Claude Code:

The skill will then guide you through the required steps and parameters.

sessionsBySequence.sessiontitle: Reimagining Application Development and Maintenance with SAP CAP & Fiori MCP Servers
sessionsBySequence.description:
This session introduces a new paradigm powered by SAP MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers for CAP and Fiori. By exposing application context, metadata, and tooling directly to AI agents(like joule, claude, cline, etc.), MCP servers unlock three transformative capabilities:

**Maintenance**: Diagnose issues in running CAP services, refine CDS models, update annotations, adjust Fiori element configurations, and validate changes without leaving your AI-assisted workflow. The MCP server acts as a live bridge between the agent and your application's structure, making targeted, context-aware edits instead of guesswork.

**Development**: Scaffold new CAP projects, generate service definitions, wire up Fiori apps, and iterate on UI layouts through natural language interactions — all grounded in real tooling, not hallucinated boilerplate.

**Rapid Prototyping**: Go from idea to a working SAP application prototype in a fraction of the usual time. MCP-powered agents handle the scaffolding, wiring, and configuration so teams can validate concepts early, gather feedback faster, and reduce the cost of iteration before committing to a full build.

Together, these capabilities shift the developer's role from executing repetitive tasks to directing intelligent agents that understand SAP conventions and act on them precisely.

Thus by using  MCP-powered tooling can reduce maintenance toil, compress the development lifecycle, and accelerate prototyping for SAP applications.

sessionsBySequence.description:

- In-flight anomaly detection

Built from real-world implementation experience on SAP BAIP(BTP), every pattern runs in a live pipeline with real AI decisions happening in real time. No slides. No theory. Just a working pipeline, live failures, and AI responses you can observe and question.

sessionsBySequence.sessiontitle: Prototype: AI-Powered Employee Migration via Joule — SAP HCM to SuccessFactors EC
sessionsBySequence.description:
This is a prototype we built to explore how AI agents can simplify employee master data migration from SAP HCM PA30 to SuccessFactors Employee Central — triggered via a single natural language prompt in Joule.

Migrating employee data from HCM to EC is complex. Every employee has a unique combination of infotypes and can have different employment scenarios — simple employment, concurrent employment, global transfer, global assignment, or rehire. Each scenario requires a completely different migration approach with different EC entities, different creation order, and different validation rules. 

The agent handles all of this automatically. It reads all PA30 infotypes, detects the employment scenario, builds a migration plan, and executes it step by step — creating all required EC entities via the OData API in the correct order. It also supports a test run mode to validate data without writing to EC, which is useful for QA before going live.

The most exciting part is the Joule integration. The HR consultant simply opens Joule and types "Migrate employee 00618676" — Joule routes the request to the agent via DAS capability framework and streams the response back in the chat. No tools, no scripts, no technical knowledge needed.

The agent is built using LangGraph with Claude 4.5 Sonnet via SAP AI Core, deployed on SAP App Foundation on Kyma. It uses a knowledge base of 177 field mappings across 24 EC entities built from real-world migration experience.

In this session we will do a live end-to-end demo — trigger a migration from Joule, watch the agent work in real time, and see the full summary of migrated entities. This prototype shows what is possible when you combine AI agents, Joule, and deep domain knowledge — and we hope it inspires the SAP community to explore similar ideas.

sessionsBySequence.sessiontitle: Smart Collaboration in RAP: AI-Powered Reusable Notes with integration of SAP AI Core & ISLM
sessionsBySequence.description:
# Abstract / Session Description

Collaborative Drafts in the ABAP RESTful Application Programming Model (RAP) allow multiple users to work on shared business objects concurrently. But how do we make multi-user editing smarter, modular, and automated?

In this technical deep-dive, we showcase how to embed a dependent RAP Business Object for Notes as a reusable component within a Collaborative Draft environment. We then supercharge this reusable Notes BO by integrating Generative AI directly into the editing lifecycle. Powered by **SAP AI Core** and orchestrated natively inside S/4HANA via the **Intelligent Scenario Lifecycle Management (ISLM)** framework, GenAI generates contextual summaries and key takeaways right within the draft instance before changes are committed to active persistence.

Join us to learn how to combine modular RAP architecture with Clean Core AI integrations to deliver intelligent, team-first Fiori applications on S/4HANA.
